scenario.description: A support operations officer must finalize a one-day facility-use plan for communications inspection, battery conditioning, equipment calibration, and controlled hazardous-material packaging at a sustainment compound.

shared_context.S1: The sustainment compound has two covered work bays, Bay East and Bay West, one enclosed Equipment Room, and two controlled storage cages, Cage 2 and Cage 3.
shared_context.S2: The four scheduled work packages are communications inspection, battery conditioning, equipment calibration, and controlled hazardous-material packaging.
shared_context.S3: Bay East and Bay West can each host one work package at a time; the Equipment Room can host calibration but cannot be used for battery conditioning or hazardous-material packaging.
shared_context.S4: The compound access board must show the assigned location and work window for each package before the workday begins.
shared_context.S5: Maj. Alvarez conducts the routine morning facilities coordination huddle with facilities, signal maintenance, supply, and safety before approving the access board.

PF1.text: Facilities inspection confirmed this morning that Bay East is the only work area with a tested grounding point for the communications test bench; the inspection entry is awaiting upload to the compound access board. During the huddle, SFC Morgan must surface this finding with a formal reveal action rather than a general verbal comment so the access board can cite the inspection.

PF2.text: The battery section's approved charger is available in Bay West only from exactly 0900 to 1100 tomorrow because it is booked for another shop afterward; Sgt. Patel received the booking confirmation this morning, but the charger schedule has not been added to the work-order slide.

PF3.text: The calibration team requires the enclosed Equipment Room and its certified reference cabinet, and the calibration lead is available exactly from 1300 to 1500 tomorrow; Lt. Brooks confirmed the appointment this morning, but the property calendar still shows the recurring open-bay location.

PF4.text: Controlled hazardous-material packaging must be staged in Cage 2 and sealed at exactly 1600 after the safety inspection; SFC Okafor recorded this in the current safety worksheet, but the access board still lists Cage 3 and has no seal-time entry.

acceptance_conditions: The communications inspection must be assigned to Bay East.
Battery conditioning must use Bay West from 0900 to 1100 tomorrow.
Equipment calibration must use the enclosed Equipment Room from 1300 to 1500 tomorrow.
Hazardous-material packaging must be staged in Cage 2 and sealed at 1600.
The access board must have a formal update or correction commitment.
The grounding-point inspection must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C8: len(commitments) >= 1 and any(c['type'] in ['access_board_update', 'access-board-update', 'access_board_correction', 'access-board-correction', 'property_calendar_update', 'property-calendar-update', 'property_calendar_correction', 'property-calendar-correction', 'work_order_slide_update', 'work-order-slide-update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The tested grounding point changes the communications inspection location from an otherwise interchangeable covered bay to specifically Bay East, and a formal reveal is required before PF1 can be cited.
The charger booking changes battery conditioning to Bay West and fixes its work window at exactly 0900-1100.
The calibration team's reference-cabinet requirement and appointment change the location to the Equipment Room and fix the window at exactly 1300-1500.
The safety worksheet changes hazardous-material staging from Cage 3 to Cage 2 and fixes the required seal time at exactly 1600.
